pilot.name: Long Xuyen, An Giang
pilot.scope_note: Rules are pilot-context rules, not province-wide prescriptions.

applicability.unsupported_reason: Seasonal calendars and crop transitions are verified only for the Long Xuyen pilot point; no regional generalization is authorized.

regions.name: Long Xuyen, An Giang
regions.applicability_note: Exact pilot point only; calendar and transition fields inherit the legacy verified rules below.

maize.note: No verified Long Xuyen-specific maize planting calendar was located; do not infer dates from rice windows.

mung_bean.note: No verified Long Xuyen-specific mung-bean planting calendar was located.

soybean.note: No verified Long Xuyen-specific soybean planting calendar was located.

hard_constraints: Requires an irrigation/rainfall plan capable of paddy saturation and water-layer management.
soft_suitability: Prefer pH 5.5-7.0 and low salinity; use catalog optimal range.

hard_constraints: Do not recommend without a water plan when farmer reports limited freshwater and no effective rainfall plan.
soft_suitability: Prefer pH 5.0-7.0, medium soil depth and high fertility.

hard_constraints: Do not claim suitability when soil EC or pH is unknown; mung bean prefers well-drained soil and is adversely affected by excessive rainfall around flowering.
soft_suitability: Prefer pH 5.5-6.2 and residual soil moisture after rice; seasonal water need remains unknown.

hard_constraints: Do not claim nitrogen benefit without effective inoculation/Bradyrhizobium establishment.
soft_suitability: Prefer pH 5.5-6.5, well-drained medium soil and low salinity.

hard_constraints: Harvest rice and drain field sufficiently before planting; verify field trafficability.
soft_benefits: Short-duration legume can fit after rice where residual moisture and dry weather are available.

hard_constraints: Do not plant without drainage and water control after rice.
soft_benefits: A Mekong Delta field experiment used soybean in the dry-season rotation followed by two rice crops; nitrogen benefit remains conditional on inoculation and management.

hard_constraints: Do not assume residual nitrogen is sufficient; test soil and manage nutrients.
soft_benefits: Legumes can fix atmospheric nitrogen when effective rhizobia are present; maize has high nitrogen demand.

hard_constraints: No recommendation for continuous maize without nutrient and pest/disease plan.

scoring_policy.hard_constraints: A failed hard constraint makes the scenario unsuitable; missing input is unknown, not pass.
scoring_policy.soft_suitability: Only score sourced conditions; absent soil salinity EC, water availability or crop-specific windows produce warnings.
